title: Midnight Drive
aesthetic: nocturnal synthwave cruise — groove and motion: a shuffled pocket, filters that breathe open, pads that swell, an arp that drifts across the stereo field
_feature_note: This group is the worked demo for the expression tools that shape sound *over time*: track/section 'swing' for a shuffled pocket, per-part 'automation' envelopes (ramp or lfo) driving 'filter', 'gain', and 'pan', and per-part 'sidechain' ducking (the kick-triggered pump). Everything else (motif reuse, sections, arp) is here only to give those tools something to move.
_motifs_note: cruise was SEEDED, not recalled: scripts/melodyseed.py rolled the frame 'A mixolydian' (seed 'midnight-drive') to escape the A-minor tonic-arp default. Shaped from that roll into a 16-beat question+answer sentence — the antecedent opens on the major 3rd (C#5) and hangs on the mixolydian ♭7 (G5); the consequent answers from a new high A5 and steps home to the tonic. It states whole in the loop and returns sliced (its rising head) in the outro.
